hotspots.title: Bell
hotspots.description: The flared opening where the sound leaves the instrument. The player’s right hand rests inside it and shapes the tone.

hotspots.title: Mouthpiece
hotspots.description: The cup the player buzzes their lips into. That buzz sets the air column vibrating and starts the note.

hotspots.title: Valves
hotspots.description: Pressed with the left hand, they add extra lengths of tubing and lower the pitch, filling in the notes between the horn’s open harmonics.

hotspots.title: Coils
hotspots.description: The tubing wound into loops so the horn’s length stays compact enough to hold. That length is what gives the instrument its low pitch.
